column1: # Japanese numbers in hiragana (phase 1, 2026-10-08). Kanji numerals stay written.
# Digit by digit (phone numbers, codes) 2 and 5 lengthen: にー, ごー (2026-10-08).
# Place values; sound changes are data (さんびゃく, ろっぴゃく, はっせん).
# Myriad scales by power of ten; a written 万 億 兆 千 after digits joins the number.
# date_cue / fraction_cue: words near M/D that make it a date or a fraction
